project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler, Tailwind CSS v4, localStorage persistence
test_framework: No test framework installed - use npm run build and npm run lint for validation
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm no compile errors. 2. Run npm run lint to confirm no lint errors.
environment_constraints: Network available for npm installs. No Docker daemon. No test framework (jest/vitest) installed.
contribution_requirements: Branch from stage-16-help-onboarding, commit all changes on stage-17-mobile-pwa branch
key_patterns: All pages in src/pages/, components organized by feature in src/components/<feature>/, global state in src/context/AppContext.jsx with localStorage write-through, custom hooks in src/hooks/, utilities in src/lib/, Tailwind CSS v4 with @theme custom colors in src/index.css, Layout uses fixed sidebar w-[220px] with ml-[220px] offset, routes defined in src/App.jsx with eager imports, Lucide React for icons, Recharts for charts
directory_structure: src/pages/ (16 page components), src/components/ (18 feature dirs + layout + search), src/hooks/ (useDebounce, useAcquisitionCRUD), src/lib/ (storage, calculations, constants, searchUtils), src/context/ (AppContext), public/ (favicon.svg only)
